Professional Summary

SEO, Google Ads, Google Analytics, Social Media Marketing, HubSpot, Confluence, Jira, Agile

- Managed Google Analytics implementation and reporting framework to measure funnel conversion; used insights to reduce CPA on Google Ads campaigns by 32% and improve LTV:CAC through targeted social creatives.
- Directed Social Media Marketing initiatives across LinkedIn and Twitter, increasing qualified lead generation through content and paid promotion; coordinated HubSpot lead capture workflows and scoring with sales.

Digital Marketing Manager, Wipro (Oct 2016 - Sep 2019)
- Executed enterprise SEO programs for service pages and thought leadership, driving a 36% increase in organic lead form submissions; tracked performance via Google Analytics and provided recommendations through Confluence documentation.
- Managed Google Ads campaigns for global accounts, optimizing keywords and bids to lower CPL by 28%; integrated campaign data into HubSpot for lead nurturing and attribution.
- Oversaw Social Media Marketing for product launches and demand generation, leveraging Agile processes and Jira to manage content production, approvals, and performance iterations.
